note: Deeper than 高兴: a lasting sense of well-being.

examples.zh: 看到孩子笑，我觉得很幸福。
examples.en: Seeing my child smile, I feel very happy.

examples.zh: 祝你们幸福！
examples.en: I wish you happiness!

examples.zh: 一家人在一起，就是幸福。
examples.en: Being together as a family is happiness.

examples.zh: 他在一家公司做技术工作。
examples.en: He does technical work at a company.

examples.zh: 这种技术学起来不难。
examples.en: This skill is not hard to learn.

examples.zh: 我想学一门新技术。
examples.en: I want to learn a new skill.

meaning: to pass on, to spread; to transmit

senses.en: to pass on, to spread; to transmit

note: Covers passing a ball, spreading news and infecting people.

examples.zh: 请把球传给我。
examples.en: Please pass the ball to me.

examples.zh: 这种病会传给别人，你要小心。
examples.en: This illness can spread to others, so be careful.

examples.zh: 好消息很快传开了。
examples.en: The good news spread quickly.

examples.zh: 你有什么困难，就告诉我。
examples.en: If you have any difficulty, tell me.

examples.zh: 这件事不太困难，我来做。
examples.en: This isn't too difficult; I'll do it.

examples.zh: 刚到中国的时候，我有很多困难。
examples.en: When I first arrived in China, I had many difficulties.

note: Typical: 紧急情况 (emergency), 紧急通知 (urgent notice).

examples.zh: 有紧急的事，请马上给我打电话。
examples.en: If something urgent comes up, call me right away.

examples.zh: 有紧急情况，请找服务员。
examples.en: In an emergency, please find a staff member.

examples.zh: 他接到一个紧急通知，马上回公司了。
examples.en: He got an urgent notice and went straight back to the company.

examples.zh: 这支乐队的歌我都会唱。
examples.en: I can sing all of this band's songs.

examples.zh: 我哥哥参加了学校的乐队。
examples.en: My brother joined the school band.

examples.zh: 晚上有乐队表演，你想去看吗？
examples.en: There's a band performance tonight; do you want to go?

meaning: to approach, to get close to; close to

senses.en: to approach, to get close to; close to

examples.zh: 天气接近三十度，太热了。
examples.en: It's close to thirty degrees; it's too hot.

examples.zh: 现在接近十二点，我们去吃饭吧。
examples.en: It's almost twelve; let's go eat.

examples.zh: 他不爱说话，别人很难接近他。
examples.en: He doesn't like to talk, so it's hard for others to get close to him.

examples.zh: 楼下太吵了，我睡不好。
examples.en: It's too noisy downstairs and I can't sleep well.

examples.zh: 别吵了，我们好好谈一谈。
examples.en: Stop arguing; let's talk properly.

examples.zh: 这家饭馆太吵，我们换一家吧。
examples.en: This restaurant is too noisy; let's go to another.

examples.zh: 我们家有四个成员。
examples.en: There are four members in our family.

examples.zh: 他是这个小组的成员。
examples.en: He is a member of this group.

examples.zh: 所有成员都要参加明天的会议。
examples.en: All members must attend tomorrow's meeting.

note: Animal fur or body hair, not the hair on a person's head (头发).

examples.zh: 这只小猫的毛很长。
examples.en: This kitten's fur is very long.

examples.zh: 家里到处都是狗毛，太脏了。
examples.en: There's dog hair everywhere; it's so dirty.

examples.zh: 你看，这只鸟的毛很漂亮。
examples.en: Look, this bird's feathers are beautiful.

examples.zh: 我请了一位游泳教练。
examples.en: I hired a swimming coach.

examples.zh: 教练要求我们每天跑步。
examples.en: The coach requires us to run every day.

examples.zh: 他以前是足球教练。
examples.en: He used to be a soccer coach.

meaning: the other party, the other side

senses.en: the other party, the other side

examples.zh: 打电话时，要听清楚对方的话。
examples.en: When you make a call, listen carefully to what the other person says.

examples.zh: 我们要先听听对方怎么说。
examples.en: We should first hear what the other side says.

examples.zh: 对方没接电话，我一会儿再打。
examples.en: The other person didn't answer; I'll call again in a moment.

note: This is bēi (carry); bèi is "back" or "memorize".

examples.zh: 她背着孩子去医院。
examples.en: She carried her child on her back to the hospital.

examples.zh: 他背着一个很大的包。
examples.en: He carries a very big bag on his back.

examples.zh: 我腿疼，你能背我一下吗？
examples.en: My leg hurts; can you carry me on your back for a bit?

examples.zh: 你想选什么职业？
examples.en: What profession do you want to choose?

examples.zh: 医生是一个很累的职业。
examples.en: Doctor is a very tiring profession.

examples.zh: 她的职业是老师。
examples.en: Her occupation is teacher.

meaning: to have a talk; a conversation

senses.en: to have a talk; a conversation

note: Often a serious or one-on-one talk, e.g. with a teacher or boss.

examples.zh: 老师想和你谈话。
examples.en: The teacher wants to talk with you.

examples.zh: 昨天经理和我有一次谈话。
examples.en: Yesterday the manager and I had a talk.

examples.zh: 他们谈话到很晚。
examples.en: They talked until very late.

meaning: to arrange, to schedule; to line up

senses.en: to arrange, to schedule; to line up

examples.zh: 请大家排好队。
examples.en: Everyone, please line up properly.

examples.zh: 这个星期的工作已经排好了。
examples.en: This week's work has already been scheduled.

examples.zh: 明天的会议排在下午三点。
examples.en: Tomorrow's meeting is scheduled for three in the afternoon.

examples.zh: 他家养了十头猪。
examples.en: His family keeps ten pigs.

examples.zh: 我不吃猪肉，吃鱼。
examples.en: I don't eat pork; I eat fish.

examples.zh: 这头猪很大，吃得很多。
examples.en: This pig is big and eats a lot.

meaning: to follow; to go along with; depending on

senses.en: to follow; to go along with; depending on

note: 随你 = "up to you"; 随着 = "as, along with".

examples.zh: 请随我来。
examples.en: Please follow me.

examples.zh: 去哪儿吃饭，随你。
examples.en: Where we eat is up to you.

examples.zh: 价格会随时间变化。
examples.en: Prices change over time.

examples.zh: 我想吃牛肉面。
examples.en: I'd like to eat beef noodles.

examples.zh: 路边有几头牛。
examples.en: There are a few cows by the road.

examples.zh: 你真牛！一次就考过了。
examples.en: You're awesome! You passed on the first try.

meaning: to go up, to climb up

senses.en: to go up, to climb up

note: Also a direction complement: 爬上去, 走上去.

examples.zh: 楼上有人等你，你快上去吧。
examples.en: Someone is waiting for you upstairs; go up quickly.

examples.zh: 你先上去，我马上就来。
examples.en: You go up first; I'll be right there.

examples.zh: 这座山不高，一小时就能爬上去。
examples.en: This hill isn't high; you can climb up in an hour.
